name: Canada Global (T.R) Ltd
summary: Canada Global (T.R) Ltd specializes in commercial property, managing the full spectrum of activities from acquisition and enhancement to development, leasing, and ongoing oversight, primarily within the United States and Serbia. The firm, which was incorporated in 1992, officially adopted its current name in March 2023, having previously been known as Aviv Arlon Ltd. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Ramat Gan, Israel.
